missing_evidence: Vendor authorization or change-order documentation reconciling the vendor discrepancy between PO-1010 (Crestline Data Services Pvt. Ltd.) and all downstream documents (Beacon IT Consulting Pvt. Ltd.)

Explanatory documentation for the payment (BNK-1010/LED-1010, dated 2026-09-10) occurring before the invoice date (INV-1010, dated 2026-09-20), such as an advance-payment agreement or pre-payment authorization
notes: All five expected document types for this transaction are present (purchase order, invoice, receipt, ledger entry, bank statement) and are linked by consistent cross-references (PO-1010, INV-1010, REC-1010, BNK-1010) and a consistent amount of 70800.0 INR with tax_amount of 10800.0 where itemized. However, two unresolved issues prevent high confidence: (1) PO-1010 names the vendor as 'Crestline Data Services Pvt. Ltd.' while every other document in the chain (invoice, receipt, ledger, bank statement) names 'Beacon IT Consulting Pvt. Ltd.' - this is a material vendor mismatch that internal consistency among the other four documents cannot resolve or excuse, since the PO itself is the outlier and no substitution/authorization document is present. (2) The date sequence is illogical: PO-1010 (2026-08-01) precedes REC-1010 (2026-09-03), which precedes the ledger/bank payment (2026-09-10), which precedes INV-1010 (2026-09-20) - meaning payment was recorded before the invoice was issued. A successful-looking payment flow does not itself establish that this sequence was proper or that any advance-payment terms were satisfied; only explicit supporting documentation could do so, and none is present. These two anomalies are flagged as missing evidence rather than assumed benign, in line with audit policy not to let document presence or internal consistency substitute for actual proof.
